title: Git
description: Exposes local Git repository operations as agent tools.
Covers clone, init, status, log, show, diff, blame, stage, commit, stash, branch management, pull, push, and code search.
Runs entirely in-process without requiring a host git installation.
Supports secure authentication via personal access tokens and SSH keys.

git.repoPath.title: Repository Path
git.repoPath.description: Local path to an existing repository, or a remote URL (https://, git@, ssh://). A remote URL is cloned into a temporary directory at pipeline start and cleaned up on exit. Leave blank to let the agent call clone or init at runtime.

git.username.title: Username
git.username.description: Git username for token-based HTTPS authentication.

git.token.title: Token / Password
git.token.description: Personal access token or password for HTTPS authentication.

git.sshKey.title: SSH Private Key
git.sshKey.description: PEM-encoded SSH private key content (starts with -----BEGIN ...).

git.sshPassphrase.title: SSH Key Passphrase
git.sshPassphrase.description: Passphrase for the SSH private key, if encrypted. Leave empty for unencrypted keys.

git.safeMode.title: Safe Mode
git.safeMode.description: Block destructive operations: force-push and force branch deletion. Normal branch deletion is allowed only when the branch is fully merged into HEAD; deleting an unmerged branch requires force=true (which is blocked in safe mode). Recommended for agent use.

git.readOnlyMode.title: Read-Only Mode
git.readOnlyMode.description: Block ALL write operations (clone, init, write_file, stage, commit, stash push/pop/drop, branch create/delete, checkout, merge, fetch, pull, push). Read-only tools (status, log, show, diff, blame, file_at, branch_list, grep, ls_files, stash list) remain available. Strictly stronger than Safe Mode. Recommended when the agent only needs to inspect a repository.
enum: No: allow writes (subject to Safe Mode)

properties.name: authType
properties.title: Authentication Type
properties.description: How to authenticate with remote repositories.
